dedupe_keys.name: chongqing yuelai sponge city monitoring intelligent stormwater control system suez aquadvanced

description: This vendor case page, in Chinese, describes how Chongqing, one of China's 30 sponge city pilots with annual rainfall over 1,000 millimetres and a hilly terrain that limits underground drainage, used Suez's AQUADVANCED urban drainage management system in the Yuelai district of the Liangjiang New Area. The system uses sensors in the drainage network and receiving waters plus short-term weather forecasts to give real-time information on network operation, waterlogging risk, effects on ecology and stormwater reuse, and to calculate sponge city performance indicators, and it had been used in twenty other cities including Barcelona and Singapore. Phase 1 of the Yuelai monitoring and information platform finished in January 2018 and covers 18.67 square kilometres. Coverage: one district, phase 1 only. Access: a free web page; the licence is not stated. Caveats: a marketing account with no measured flood reduction or cost data. It supports drainage operations, sponge city monitoring and digital twin design, and relates to the Resilio Amsterdam smart blue-green roofs case study in the catalogue.
